d: ITSV-5 HD IP Video Phone with 8" Screen

specs.label: Graphic Display
specs.value: 8” (1280x800) capacitive (10 points) touch screen IPS LCD

specs.label: Camera
specs.value: Tiltable 2 mega-pixel CMOS camera with privacy shutter, 1080P@30fps

specs.label: Auxiliary Ports
specs.value: RJ9 headset jack (allowing EHS with Plantronics headsets), 3.5mm stereo headset with microphone, USB 3.0 port, Type-C, HDMI-out, HDMI-in

specs.label: Feature keys
specs.value: 2 function touch keys VOLUME +/-, 3 dedicated Android touch keys HOME, MENU, and BACK

specs.label: Power options
specs.value: Power over Ethernet (PoE & PoE+) or power adapter.

specs.label: Network Interface
specs.value: 2 x RJ45 (Ethernet) 10/100/1000 Mbps with integrated PoE/PoE+
